chapter.heading: Psalm 120Prayer for Breaking Away from the Treacherous.A Song of Ascents.
chapter.v:
In my
trouble I cried to the Lord,And He answered me.

Rescue my
soul, O Lord, from lying lips,And from a deceitful tongue.

What shall
be given to you, and what more shall be done to you,You deceitful tongue?—

Sharp arrows
of the warrior,With the burning coals of the broom tree.

¶Woe to
me, for I sojourn in Meshech,and I live among the tents of Kedar [among hostile people]! [Gen 10:2; 25:13; Jer 49:28, 29]

Too long
my soul has had its dwellingWith those who hate peace.

I am
for peace, but when I speak,They are for war.
